<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 380" width="100%" height="100%">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="teaGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#8B4513" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#5C2E0B" />
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="cupGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFFFFF" />
      <stop offset="70%" stop-color="#F1F5F9" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#CBD5E1" />
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="gaugeGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#EF4444" />
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#F59E0B" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#3B82F6" />
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Table surface -->
  <line x1="40" y1="320" x2="560" y2="320" stroke="#94A3B8" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" />
  <line x1="60" y1="328" x2="540" y2="328" stroke="#E2E8F0" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" />

  <!-- Saucer and Cup Body -->
  <g id="cup_body">
    <!-- Saucer -->
    <ellipse cx="280" cy="315" rx="140" ry="22" fill="url(#cupGrad)" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="3" />
    <ellipse cx="280" cy="313" rx="95" ry="13" fill="#E2E8F0" stroke="#94A3B8" stroke-width="1.5" />
    <!-- Cup handle -->
    <path d="M 360,205 C 415,205 415,270 355,275" fill="none" stroke="url(#cupGrad)" stroke-width="16" stroke-linecap="round" />
    <path d="M 360,205 C 415,205 415,270 355,275" fill="none" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" />
    <!-- Cup Base -->
    <path d="M 200,180 C 200,290 230,305 280,305 C 330,305 360,290 360,180 Z" fill="url(#cupGrad)" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round" />
    <!-- Tea Rim & Surface -->
    <ellipse cx="280" cy="180" rx="80" ry="24" fill="#E2E8F0" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="3" />
    <ellipse cx="280" cy="182" rx="72" ry="19" fill="url(#teaGrad)" />
    <ellipse cx="270" cy="180" rx="50" ry="10" fill="#A0522D" opacity="0.6" />
  </g>

  <!-- Rising Steam -->
  <g id="steam">
    <path d="M 250,155 Q 235,120 250,90 T 240,35" fill="none" stroke="#94A3B8" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-dasharray="6 4" opacity="0.75" />
    <path d="M 280,150 Q 295,115 280,80 T 290,25" fill="none" stroke="#38BDF8" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.85" />
    <path d="M 310,158 Q 325,125 310,95 T 320,40" fill="none" stroke="#94A3B8" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-dasharray="6 4" opacity="0.75" />
    <text x="280" y="16" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Quicksand, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#0284C7">Vapour & Steam Rising</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Radiating Heat Loss Arrows -->
  <g id="heat_loss">
    <path d="M 175,230 Q 140,225 110,210" fill="none" stroke="#EF4444" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round" marker-end="none" />
    <polygon points="106,206 118,206 112,218" fill="#EF4444" transform="rotate(35 110 210)" />

    <path d="M 185,270 Q 145,280 115,295" fill="none" stroke="#EF4444" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round" />
    <polygon points="111,291 123,291 117,303" fill="#EF4444" transform="rotate(-35 115 295)" />

    <path d="M 375,230 Q 410,225 440,210" fill="none" stroke="#EF4444" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round" />
    <polygon points="436,206 448,206 442,218" fill="#EF4444" transform="rotate(-35 440 210)" />

    <text x="85" y="190" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Quicksand, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#DC2626">Heat Radiating Out</text>
    <text x="85" y="206" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Quicksand, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#64748B">Energy transfer to air</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Temperature Gauge / Thermometer -->
  <g id="temp_gauge">
    <rect x="470" y="70" width="85" height="200" rx="12" fill="#F8FAFC" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="2.5" />
    <!-- Tube -->
    <rect x="502" y="85" width="14" height="150" rx="7" fill="#E2E8F0" />
    <rect x="502" y="130" width="14" height="105" rx="7" fill="url(#gaugeGrad)" />
    <circle cx="509" cy="240" r="16" fill="#3B82F6" stroke="#1D4ED8" stroke-width="2" />
    <!-- Markings -->
    <line x1="520" y1="95" x2="530" y2="95" stroke="#EF4444" stroke-width="2" />
    <text x="534" y="99" font-family="Quicksand, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" fill="#EF4444">75°C (Hot)</text>

    <line x1="520" y1="160" x2="530" y2="160" stroke="#F59E0B" stroke-width="2" />
    <text x="534" y="164" font-family="Quicksand, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" fill="#D97706">50°C</text>

    <line x1="520" y1="225" x2="530" y2="225" stroke="#3B82F6" stroke-width="2" />
    <text x="534" y="229" font-family="Quicksand, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" fill="#2563EB">25°C (Room)</text>

    <text x="512" y="285" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Quicksand, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" fill="#0F172A">Cooling Down</text>
  </g>
</svg>
d_daily_phenomena:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 720 380" width="100%" height="100%">
  <!-- Card 1: Boiling Milk -->
  <g id="card_cooking">
    <rect x="30" y="40" width="200" height="300" rx="16" fill="#FEF3C7" stroke="#F59E0B" stroke-width="2.5" />
    <rect x="30" y="40" width="200" height="44" rx="16" fill="#FDE68A" />
    <text x="130" y="68" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Quicksand, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#92400E">1. Boiling Milk</text>

    <!-- Pan & Milk -->
    <path d="M 65,220 C 65,260 85,270 130,270 C 175,270 195,260 195,220 Z" fill="#94A3B8" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2.5" />
    <ellipse cx="130" cy="220" rx="65" ry="16" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#CBD5E1" stroke-width="2" />
    <!-- Foam Bubbles rising -->
    <circle cx="110" cy="205" r="12" fill="#FFFBEB" stroke="#FDE68A" stroke-width="2" />
    <circle cx="135" cy="195" r="16" fill="#FFFBEB" stroke="#FDE68A" stroke-width="2" />
    <circle cx="155" cy="208" r="10" fill="#FFFBEB" stroke="#FDE68A" stroke-width="2" />
    <!-- Flame -->
    <path d="M 115,295 Q 130,275 130,285 Q 140,272 145,295 Z" fill="#EF4444" />

    <text x="130" y="310" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Quicksand, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#78350F">Heat Expansion & State Change</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Card 2: Rusting of Iron -->
  <g id="card_rusting">
    <rect x="260" y="40" width="200" height="300" rx="16" fill="#FFEDD5" stroke="#EA580C" stroke-width="2.5" />
    <rect x="260" y="40" width="200" height="44" rx="16" fill="#FED7AA" />
    <text x="360" y="68" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Quicksand, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#9A3412">2. Rusting of Iron</text>

    <!-- Shiny Nail -->
    <rect x="310" y="120" width="12" height="95" rx="2" fill="#CBD5E1" stroke="#64748B" stroke-width="2" />
    <polygon points="306,120 326,120 316,110" fill="#64748B" />
    <polygon points="310,215 322,215 316,230" fill="#64748B" />
    <text x="316" y="250" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Quicksand, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" fill="#64748B">New Nail</text>

    <!-- Rusted Nail -->
    <rect x="390" y="120" width="14" height="95" rx="2" fill="#9A3412" stroke="#7C2D12" stroke-width="2" />
    <polygon points="386,120 408,120 397,110" fill="#7C2D12" />
    <polygon points="390,215 404,215 397,230" fill="#7C2D12" />
    <!-- Flaky spots -->
    <circle cx="394" cy="150" r="3" fill="#F97316" />
    <circle cx="401" cy="175" r="4" fill="#EA580C" />
    <circle cx="395" cy="195" r="3" fill="#C2410C" />
    <text x="397" y="250" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Quicksand, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" fill="#9A3412">Rusted Nail</text>

    <text x="360" y="285" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Quicksand, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" fill="#C2410C">Iron + Moisture + O2</text>
    <text x="360" y="310" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Quicksand, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#7C2D12">Permanent Chemical Change</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Card 3: Morning Dew Drops -->
  <g id="card_weather">
    <rect x="490" y="40" width="200" height="300" rx="16" fill="#E0F2FE" stroke="#0284C7" stroke-width="2.5" />
    <rect x="490" y="40" width="200" height="44" rx="16" fill="#BAE6FD" />
    <text x="590" y="68" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Quicksand, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#0369A1">3. Morning Dew</text>

    <!-- Leaf with Dew Drops -->
    <path d="M 530,225 C 530,135 620,135 650,225 C 620,240 550,240 530,225 Z" fill="#22C55E" stroke="#15803D" stroke-width="2.5" />
    <path d="M 530,225 Q 590,185 650,225" fill="none" stroke="#166534" stroke-width="2" />
    <!-- Dew drops -->
    <circle cx="570" cy="175" r="8" fill="#E0F2FE" stroke="#0284C7" stroke-width="2" />
    <ellipse cx="568" cy="173" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#FFFFFF" />
    <circle cx="610" cy="195" r="6" fill="#E0F2FE" stroke="#0284C7" stroke-width="1.5" />
    <ellipse cx="608" cy="193" rx="2" ry="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF" />

    <text x="590" y="285" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Quicksand, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" fill="#0284C7">Water Vapour → Liquid</text>
    <text x="590" y="310" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Quicksand, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#075985">Condensation via Cooling</text>
  </g>
</svg>
d_inquiry_cycle:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 680 340" width="100%" height="100%">
  <!-- Step 1: Observe -->
  <g id="step_observe">
    <rect x="30" y="110" width="135" height="120" rx="16" fill="#EFF6FF" stroke="#3B82F6" stroke-width="2.5" />
    <circle cx="97" cy="145" r="22" fill="#DBEAFE" />
    <ellipse cx="97" cy="145" rx="14" ry="8" fill="none" stroke="#1D4ED8" stroke-width="2" />
    <circle cx="97" cy="145" r="4" fill="#1D4ED8" />
    <text x="97" y="190" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Quicksand, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#1E40AF">1. Observe</text>
    <text x="97" y="210" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Quicksand, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#3B82F6">Using all 5 senses</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Arrow 1 -> 2 -->
  <g id="arrow_1">
    <line x1="175" y1="170" x2="195" y2="170" stroke="#94A3B8" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" />
    <polygon points="195,164 205,170 195,176" fill="#94A3B8" />
  </g>

  <!-- Step 2: Question -->
  <g id="step_question">
    <rect x="215" y="110" width="135" height="120" rx="16" fill="#FEF3C7" stroke="#F59E0B" stroke-width="2.5" />
    <circle cx="282" cy="145" r="22" fill="#FDE68A" />
    <text x="282" y="153" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Quicksand, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="900" fill="#B45309">?</text>
    <text x="282" y="190" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Quicksand, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#92400E">2. Question</text>
    <text x="282" y="210" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Quicksand, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#B45309">Why & How does it occur?</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Arrow 2 -> 3 -->
  <g id="arrow_2">
    <line x1="360" y1="170" x2="380" y2="170" stroke="#94A3B8" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" />
    <polygon points="380,164 390,170 380,176" fill="#94A3B8" />
  </g>

  <!-- Step 3: Test & Experiment -->
  <g id="step_test">
    <rect x="400" y="110" width="135" height="120" rx="16" fill="#F0FDF4" stroke="#22C55E" stroke-width="2.5" />
    <circle cx="467" cy="145" r="22" fill="#DCFCE7" />
    <!-- Beaker/Flask icon -->
    <path d="M 462,132 L 472,132 L 472,140 L 478,154 C 480,157 478,160 474,160 L 460,160 C 456,160 454,157 456,154 L 462,140 Z" fill="#86EFAC" stroke="#15803D" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round" />
    <text x="467" y="190" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Quicksand, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#166534">3. Experiment</text>
    <text x="467" y="210" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Quicksand, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#15803D">Test hypotheses</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Arrow 3 -> 4 -->
  <g id="arrow_3">
    <line x1="545" y1="170" x2="565" y2="170" stroke="#94A3B8" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" />
    <polygon points="565,164 575,170 565,176" fill="#94A3B8" />
  </g>

  <!-- Step 4: Scientific Law / Discovery -->
  <g id="step_discover">
    <rect x="585" y="110" width="85" height="120" rx="16" fill="#FAF5FF" stroke="#A855F7" stroke-width="2.5" />
    <circle cx="627" cy="145" r="22" fill="#F3E8FF" />
    <!-- Lightbulb glow -->
    <circle cx="627" cy="142" r="9" fill="#FBBF24" stroke="#D97706" stroke-width="1.5" />
    <path d="M 624,151 L 630,151 L 629,154 L 625,154 Z" fill="#78350F" />
    <text x="627" y="190" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Quicksand, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#6B21A8">4. Insight</text>
    <text x="627" y="210" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Quicksand, sans-serif" font-size="10" fill="#9333EA">Discover law</text>
  </g>
</svg>
